culture-cycles.note: Holidays the community chose or set itself for 2027 (national holidays are on Spain's record). Local town holidays are not included.

events.what: Spanish municipal elections (all town and city councils), Sunday 23 May 2027: the law sets them for the fourth Sunday of May every four years (Ceuta and Melilla also elect their city assemblies that day). This community's regional parliament follows its own calendar.
events.effect: Election day; a day of reflection beforehand. Not yet formally called.

sources.title: Ley Organica 5/1985 del Regimen Electoral General
sources.supports: fourth-Sunday-of-May rule for local elections (read directly); the 2027 date is calculated from it
